text: In October 2021 we returned, most, to one measure: nine of us said "the family violence prevention and services" on October 26, and eight of us "family violence prevention and services improvement" and "violence prevention and services improvement act" that same day. Nine of us said "the build back better" on October 28; Suzan K. DelBene had first said it on January 27, 2021. Eight of us reached for "secretary of state" on October 18. Six of us converged on the debt ceiling: "the full faith and credit of," "faith and credit of the united," and "and credit of the united states," each on October 12. These were our most-repeated phrases of the era, and the counts are our own record of ourselves.
